selection_notes: No prior package_decision.json existed for this deal — the Phase 1 review gate was opened directly from research notes without the standard revenue/team-size marketing+coaching tier logic having been run.

Seller override: Jacob Meissner requested via Slack on September 4, 2026 to set the plan to FCOO Director (the ~9 hrs/month tier) at the standard listed price, citing firm revenue of $8M and a strong growth focus.

FCOO Director standalone eligibility requires $1M+ revenue and 5+ established leaders per Design Files/Scoping_and_Ad_Spend_Guide.md Step 6B — met under either the seller-stated $8M figure or the transcript-stated ~$1.6M/year figure; team size (3 attorneys + 5 support staff, per transcript) satisfies the 5+ headcount threshold.

REVENUE CONFLICT FLAGGED: seller's Slack message states $8M revenue; the discovery-call transcript (research notes STEP 9) states revenue has been flat at ~$1.6M/year for roughly a decade. These figures differ by ~5x and were not reconciled — flagged for the sales rep to confirm the correct figure before finalizing pricing/scope with the client.

Priced as a true standalone product (no marketing tier bundled): $5,797/mo per Design Files/Scoping_and_Ad_Spend_Guide.md FCOO Director stand-alone rate, $0 savings since no bundle discount applies — consistent with prior precedent (see runion-injury-law/package_decision.json).
